title: The Magicians Believe and Moses Leaves at Night

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh promised the magicians a reward and said they would be close to him. Moses told them to throw whatever they would throw. They threw their ropes and staffs. They said, "By the might of Pharaoh, we will surely win." Then Moses threw his staff, and it swallowed up all their false tricks. At once the magicians fell down, bowing to Allah. They said, "We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Moses and Aaron."

Pharaoh was furious. He said, "You believed in him before I gave you permission! He must be your leader who taught you magic. You will soon see. I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all." The magicians were not afraid. They said, "There is no harm. We will return to our Lord. We hope our Lord will forgive our sins, because we were the first to believe."

Allah inspired Moses to travel by night with His servants, because they would be chased. Pharaoh sent men to the cities to gather his army. He told them that the believers were only a small group who made them angry. He said his people were careful and ready. So Allah removed Pharaoh's people from their gardens and springs, their treasures and their honored places.
